audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows are wrong. The page reads Lucian/Lucian/Lucian/Lucian/Skill/Skill/Skill; packet.levelChart reads Lucian/Skill/Lillia/Lillia/Lillia/Lillia/Lillia, and every why on the page agrees with the packet (whys[2] "he can't kite you and bleeds", whys[3] "Levels 4-5 are your peak", whys[4] "a real kill setup", whys[6] "He has no scaling answer to you in the 1v1"). The header is worse: diff TRICKY at 7/10 sits on top of a 61% win rate and a page whose own late-game section says "This lane stays yours".
audit.why: A player reading the header dodges or plays scared in a lane the same page then describes as a takeover from level 3 onward.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 set to Skill/Lillia/Lillia/Lillia/Lillia/Lillia in both layers, matching the packet. Ratings on rows 1-3 raised to 5/6/7. diff -> FAV, tone -> the favoured green, and breakdown.difficulty / report[14].t restated as a favoured 4/10 matchup. phases[0].why and phases[1].why rewritten so the full layer stops boasting on the two rows Lillia does not win.

audit.whatIsWrong: Relentless Pursuit is the tracked focus of the entire page and never gets a number, except dosFull[2].d's invented "fifteen-second invitation". It is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s — and it does not tick down on a fixed clock at all (see point 4).
audit.why: The page's whole plan is "commit on its cooldown", so the number has to be there and it has to be the right kind of number.
audit.corrected: 16s at rank 1 written into dosFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns, with the caveat that farming shortens it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two real interactions are absent. (a) Riot's E text: "Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown" — every double-shot he lands on a minion or on you brings the dash back sooner, so counting to sixteen after a spent dash is wrong whenever he is farming. (b) Ardent Blaze marks you and grants HIM Move Speed for attacking marked targets, which is the direct counter to the page's central claim that "the passive move speed keeps you glued to him" and "he can't kite you".
audit.why: The page tells the player to win a movement-speed race while omitting the enemy ability that wins it for him, and to count a cooldown that is not fixed.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now says to count his attacks rather than seconds; dosFull[0].d now names Ardent Blaze's mark as the thing to clear before trying to kite.

notes: No mirror existed, so this file defines the chart lucian__lillia must match: Lucian, Skill, Lillia, Lillia, Lillia, Lillia, Lillia — identical to packet.levelChart. The header change (TRICKY/7/10 -> FAV/4/10) is the one call here I would flag as Medium rather than High confidence: it rests on a 61.11% win rate over only 18 games plus the packet chart plus the page's own text, not on anything mechanical. The mechanics support it — he is a no-sustain squishy who has to walk into a percent-HP burn — but if you would rather hold the header until the sample is larger, revert the diff / tone / diffRating / carryRating / breakdown.difficulty / report[14].t edits and keep the chart flips, which stand on their own. UNVERIFIED, left in place: whys[4], spikes[2].text, content.mid and wants.you[2] all say Lilting Lullaby's sleep lands "through his E dash" / he "can't dash out of" it. Nothing in either kit says whether a dash breaks Drowsy or the sleep, so I neither built on it nor removed it. Also noted but not written: Lucian's passive gives him bonus damage on his next two attacks when a nearby enemy champion is immobilized, which means your own R sleeping someone beside him empowers him — worth a line if you want it, but I could not confirm whether Lillia's sleep counts as immobilized for that trigger.
